units.en: With Mao as your leader, win the Chinese Civil War.

This ⟦0⟧ requires ⟦1⟧ to conquer all of ⟦2⟧ starting territory in 1.16. This does not include cores owned by European countries or the warlords. Following the 1.17 patch, some territory is held by Warlords and ⟦3⟧.

As soon as you have enough political power, justify wargoals for your cores in ⟦0⟧ and then ⟦1⟧. Declare war as soon as possible. Shanxi is easily mowed down as they should only have two divisions. You don't even need to destroy them, just run around them and grab the land. Shanxi should capitulate in less than 20 days. Train as many infantry divisions as possible for the upcoming wars. For national focuses, focus on getting a third research slot, getting rid of ⟦2⟧ and to improve your ⟦3⟧. It might be possible to reach above 50% during war time early, thus avoiding Strikes, but do not count on it. Focus your political power on the Silent Workhorse, The Popular Figurehead, lowering the Conscription law to Extensive, improving your Economy and Trade laws, as well as getting the cheap Genius Army Chief.

Once the justification for ⟦0⟧ is finished, start justification on ⟦1⟧ and declare war on Xibei San Ma. They will be tougher, but, with enough fielded divisions, you can punch through a hole in the north and overwhelm them and grab the victory points. Once ⟦2⟧ capitulates, build a railway to the supply hub to the east. Declare war on ⟦3⟧ when ready, and the railway connection has been established. Use the ⟦4⟧ decision and build a railway and a supply depot near the border of ⟦5⟧. Also build a railway to the former capital of Shanxi.

Once ⟦0⟧ capitulates, place as much troops as possible on the ⟦1⟧ border. Once ⟦2⟧ declares war on ⟦3⟧, Join their faction and the war. ⟦4⟧ may not be well defended. Push there quickly as far as possible before the ⟦5⟧ place their troops. The rest will rely on China's strength and competency. It is unnecessary to place men on the Chinese-Japanese border right now. Build a lot of divisions. the 6 Infantry division template is fine, but it is a good idea to have a separate one with 9 Infantry and 1 Artillery. Push to ⟦6⟧ from your border in order to take the land instead of China. Add land forts on your border with ⟦7⟧ just in case. During this time, the ⟦8⟧ may be losing a lot of land. Help them where necessary. If any ⟦9⟧ are in your territory or bordering it, push them out there. ⟦10⟧ may not capitulate even if Chongqing falls. If they capitulate, you lose the war because you are not a major power. The main focus however, is to push the Japanese out of Manchuria. Take the ⟦11⟧ in order to get better attack against the ⟦12⟧. Remember to take ⟦13⟧ so that Mao would stay your leader. Attack weak points and encircle the Japanese. Once at Manchuria, the ⟦14⟧ would be pushing the ⟦15⟧ back in the south. Leave them alone for now so that the ⟦16⟧ gets a bit more weaker for the next war. Instead push the ⟦17⟧ out of Korea and the north. Once Japan is out of the north, Help the ⟦18⟧ and push the ⟦19⟧ out of China in the south.

Now is a good time to take the focus ⟦0⟧. Once you think the war is nearly won, with a few medium sized ⟦1⟧ patches, pause, delete a unit and take an infiltration decision. This will take 60 days. Remove the ⟦2⟧ patches during that time. As you do that, get divisions ready for the war with ⟦3⟧. When ⟦4⟧ white-peaces the Japanese, if done correctly, You will take Manchuria and ⟦5⟧. Place divisions there. After the 60 days take the infiltration decision that gets you to war with China. It will take another 60 days. When you are at war with ⟦6⟧, push quickly until their divisions are met then stall a bit while pushing not as quickly. This is also a good time to take ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, and ⟦9⟧ as they will join the Chinese United Front because they are non-aligned. ⟦10⟧, ⟦11⟧ and the rest of the middle east is good too if desired. However, ⟦12⟧ may be difficult because of the thin mountain border. Justify on 2 of them at a time. Be aware that they might join the Allies instead. When desired, capitulate and annex all of ⟦13⟧.

Japan won't white-peace with China, unless you win quickly (it seems that they won't white-peace if Japan is fighting in another war: if you drag it out till 1941, they'll declare on the Philippines or British Malaya, and you'll have to do it the hard way - either naval invasion of the Home Islands, which is hard for a landlocked country starting with zero naval tech, or wait for the USA to do it for you).

Nationalist China has a crap ton of army. Watch their division counts in the war overview as you go along. You'll have a hard enough time just getting to 50% of their division count. (But, once you get Manchukuo and Mengkukuo, you should be leading them in factories and tech).

Starting in 1938, start training and deploying divisions as soon as they can be deployed (at 10% readiness), and use a dedicated army doing exercises to bring them up to fully trained status. Rely on continuous lend-lease from southern warlords and the Soviet Union (and even from Nationalist China) to keep them armed.
When ready to go to war with China, check their diplomatic status. They may be guaranteed by the UK or the US, in which case, declaring on them is suicidal.

If you wait long enough after winning the war with Japan, China will declare on ⟦0⟧, saving you the trouble and much of the risk (you might even leave the faction and join the Comintern, to make it easier).
…and you get a canton, everybody gets a canton!
